text:
morgan: Heads up — got a support ticket where a client hit EOF mid-stream during a tool call and after reconnect the tool executed twice. User saw duplicate charges. Repro trace below.

morgan: ```
[session=abc123] 2026-03-19T14:02:12Z EOF from client
server: toolcall invoke id=tc-42 (compute)
client reconnect 14:02:18Z new request_id=r-987
resume -> server invoked toolcall id=tc-43 (same args)
billed tokens: 412 + 412
```

ops-bot: incident-log: session=abc123 eof_resume_detected=true toolcall_dup=true

jin: Oof. We dedupe by `request_id` scoped to connection. Reconnects get new ids so duplicates slip through.

sam: Confirmed. We also create provisional token rows on emission, then finalize on ack. That flow doesn't prevent double execution here.

liz: Idea — return a server `exec-id` when a toolcall starts. Client includes `exec-id` on resume and we de-dup/stream cached output if exec-id seen. Backwards compat needed.

eva: Implementation sketch: persist exec-id -> {result, billed_tokens, status} for 1h. On resume, if client sends exec-id and status=complete we stream cached result and skip re-exec. Fallback: if no exec-id, current behavior.

jin: For billing ledger: mark provisional rows with `session_id` and `exec_id=null`. On finalization set exec_id. If we later detect duplicate exec_id we can auto-refund provisional duplicates.

sam: Two practical issues: (1) need a fast exec-id lookup in the resume path, (2) older SDKs won't send exec-id so they still risk dupes.

morgan: Short-term mitigation: on resume, if same session had an in-flight toolcall within last 5m, return `409` + message asking SDK to include exec-id or wait. We'll ship an SDK patch to auto-retry with exec-id when available.

liz: Console UX — add a "session health" panel with `eof-resume rate` and a per-session "provisional tokens" line. Query example: `sum(rate(stream.eof_resume_total[5m])) by (route)`. Also a table: sessions with >1 toolcall_exec in 10m.

eva: I'll add metrics + a dashboard tile on canary (50% traffic) in the next 48h. ETA ~4h.

jin: Also need a reconciliation job that finds likely double-execs and issues credits. Rough detect: `group by session_id, tool_name, args_hash` where count(exec) > 1 within short window.

billing-bot: Note: REFUND_AUTO_DUPTOOLCALL template exists but auto-refund requires $ threshold and ops review for >$20.

sam: Rollout plan: 1) metrics + alert, 2) exec-id + persistence behind FF, 3) SDK header `X-Redwood-Exec-ID` opt-in, 4) canary 48h, 5) reconciliation + auto-refunds.

morgan: I'll open a tracking issue and link action items. @jin own the FF + server change? @eva add dashboard? @liz coordinate SDK changelog? @sam own reconciliation/job?

jin: sgtm — will open PR with exec-id schema + kallable persistence and FF.

eva: adding dashboard tomorrow.

liz: SDK note: add `X-Redwood-Exec-ID` header on resume and document migration snippet. We'll include fallback code for older SDKs.

morgan: Ops playbook (temp): if support sees duplicate charge, refund and mark session `do-not-reexec` until we finish rollout.

sam: :thumbsup:
